result.rationale: The diff's embed.html.erb sends the 'discourse-resize' postMessage only inside window.onload, and embed.js sets iframe.height solely on receiving that single message, with iframe.scrolling = 'no'. adjudication.rationale: The iframe resize message is indeed only sent once (layouts/embed.html.erb sets window.onload to post a single {type:'discourse-resize'} message, and embed.js only adjusts height when such a message arrives). However, the finding’s claim that height will go stale specifically because images/content grow *after* load isn’t verifiable from the diff: the embed content is server-rendered/static, and `window.onload` in the iframe fires after page resources (including images) finish loading, so the computed `document['body'].offsetHeight` should already reflect image-loaded layout in the normal case. No dynamic post-load DOM growth mechanism is shown in this diff.
